mapper.select: SELECT p.clubJoin_Num, p.position, p.uniform_No, p.height, p.weight, TO_CHAR(p.join_Date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS joinDate, c.club_Name, p.status FROM clubjoin cj JOIN player p ON p.clubJoin_Num = cj.clubJoin_Num JOIN club c ON p.clubOwner_Key = c.clubOwner_Key WHERE cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
